meaning: Measured cells only, same frozen protocol and gates as results/g1_wbc_envelope_v2. A cell passes when every trial met every gate (no tilt latch, no sustained undesired ground contact, foot support kept, height tracking, joint-limit contact, CoM margin, torque ratio, slip, return to nominal; push cells also recover; joint_reference cells also keep hand FK error within the stated bound). Counts and Wilson 95% intervals are the evidence; with 5 trials a perfect cell has a lower bound of about 0.57. Nothing here is labelled safe. unofficial Python/onnxruntime port of gear_sonic_deploy; not verified against the reference C++ binary.
height_m_rule: posture is listed only if at least one static cell passes 5/5; height_m = [lowest, highest] commanded height of the longest contiguous run (in the sorted list of static heights) of cells that pass 5/5 (ties: the run containing the highest height); if no static cell passes, height_m = [1.0, 0.0] (empty, nothing executable). Transitions, pushes and the grid's neighbours are reported but do not widen it.
joint_reference_rule: 'joint_reference' is listed in envelope kinds only if all six references are feasible in the planner, run, and are stable in 5/5 trials under all gates (collapse gates, torque, height tracking 0.04 m against the reference pelvis height, return to nominal, and hand FK error <= 0.05 m). Otherwise it is omitted and the per-reference counts are reported.
interpolation_rule: Heights between measured cells are executable only inside height_m (every measured cell in the span passes, which includes both neighbours of any in-span request). Everything else is unmeasured and not executable autonomously. Pushes and transitions are reported evidence beside the region, not a widening of it.
roll: Not commandable in SONIC planner mode; executable roll is fixed at 0.
world_frame_torso_attitude: recorded per segment in the trial files; not a gate
controller: unofficial Python/onnxruntime port of gear_sonic_deploy; not verified against the reference C++ binary
